strategies.name: Team strength / spread probability
strategies.hypothesis: Estimate team scoring margin from opponent-adjusted, shrinkage-regularized offense and defense features; derive a probability distribution for margin and compare its market probability to an offered price.
strategies.features: NFL team scoring and player passing/rushing/receiving summaries; add play-level efficiency, pace, venue and current-season availability only when sourced, timestamped and reproducibly licensed. Avoid raw win/loss streak narratives.
strategies.decision: Model probability, market-implied probability, price timestamp and uncertainty must all be present; no play when the conservative probability edge is not positive after uncertainty and price costs.
strategies.validation: Walk-forward by game date, train-only feature construction, season-held-out check, calibration, uncertainty interval, closing-line comparison and net return after explicit price/settlement rules.

strategies.name: Game total / team total distribution
strategies.hypothesis: Model points as an overdispersed distribution conditional on opponent-adjusted scoring, pace/possessions and game conditions; price the full over/under probability at the exact listed line, including push treatment where relevant.
strategies.features: Official team scoring; archived, date-stamped team and player stats; scoring and timing rules for the relevant season. Do not assume points are normally distributed without checking residuals.
strategies.decision: Only compare probabilities for identical market definitions and settlement rules. Keep the total and margin forecasts coherent under a shared game model.
strategies.validation: Chronological holdout; calibration by probability/line bands; compare log loss and Brier score with a predeclared baseline; account for pushes, voids and price/limits; test rules/season changes separately.

strategies.name: Player opportunity-first yardage prop
strategies.market: QB passing yards; RB rushing yards; receiver/rusher receiving yards or receptions
strategies.hypothesis: Forecast opportunity/volume first (attempts, carries, targets or routes only if reliably available), then conditional efficiency and outcome distribution; combine uncertainty rather than scaling a season average to a point estimate.
strategies.features: NFL official player passing, rushing and receiving categories plus public NGS passing fields where applicable. NGS raw tracking is not assumed to be publicly downloadable or licensed for commercial use.
strategies.decision: Compute over, under and push probabilities for the exact line/price. Account for role, team environment, opponent and injury status only from dated sources; missing status remains missing.
strategies.validation: Player/game chronological splits; role-change and injury sensitivity; calibration at prop-line thresholds; compare with simple opportunity-only and historical-rate baselines; report coverage and missingness.

strategies.name: Touchdown / scoring-event prop
strategies.market: Anytime/first touchdown or player touchdown counts (if offered)
strategies.hypothesis: Estimate scoring-event probability from opportunity and context rather than using recent touchdown totals alone; model player/team opportunity and scoring events with uncertainty and exact market settlement definitions.
strategies.features: Official NFL scoring, rushing and receiving statistics; confirm whether the offered market includes passing touchdowns, overtime, voids and tie rules before comparing prices.
strategies.decision: No recommendation from a small raw touchdown sample; require calibrated event probabilities, baseline comparison and a price-edge margin that survives uncertainty.
strategies.validation: Walk-forward event calibration and proper scoring; evaluate rare-event uncertainty; no post-hoc selection of players/thresholds; report confidence intervals and season/role splits.

strategies.name: Same-game combo with joint simulation
strategies.hypothesis: Estimate the joint result distribution of all legs under shared latent game states (pace, score differential, team opportunity and player role); calculate the joint hit probability directly rather than multiplying marginal probabilities unless independence is demonstrated.
strategies.features: Only timestamped, settled leg-level outcomes, exact lines, same-game context and matching prices. NFL NGS/traditional metrics may be candidate predictors, not substitutes for joint outcome history.
strategies.decision: Price the full joint event; display pairwise dependence estimates and interval, sample size and model risk. If relationship is unstable or insufficient data, abstain; prohibit duplicate/incompatible legs unless settlement rules are explicit.
strategies.validation: Game-blocked resampling, pre-registered leg families, held-out joint calibration and simulated-versus-realized joint frequency; test performance on unseen games and seasons.
strategies.status: UNTESTED — correlation and joint pricing unavailable

strategies.name: Cross-game parlay baseline
strategies.hypothesis: Use joint probability only after testing between-game dependence (shared weather/news/market timing and model errors can matter); independent multiplication is a baseline hypothesis, not a default fact.
strategies.features: Aligned timestamped probability forecasts and settled outcomes for each leg; league-wide conditions and common model vintage must be retained.
strategies.decision: Compare joint-model pricing against the product-of-marginals baseline out of sample. Publish the covariance/correlation estimate and interval; leave blank until an adequate sample exists.
strategies.validation: Season- and date-blocked holdouts; joint calibration, sensitivity to correlated model errors, price/settlement audit, and no repeated tuning on leaderboard holdout data.
strategies.status: UNTESTED — correlation and joint pricing unavailable

strategies.name: QB passing + receiver receiving combo
strategies.hypothesis: Jointly model QB passing volume/output and the named receiver's targets, receptions and yards; conditional relationship depends on shared team passing volume and allocation, so separate marginal hit rates do not establish independence.
strategies.features: NFL official passing/receiving categories and Next Gen passing fields; target/route inputs must be available, timestamped and validated before use.
strategies.decision: Estimate conditional and joint event probabilities for exact lines; never combine individually attractive legs by multiplication without out-of-sample dependence evidence.
strategies.validation: Game-clustered out-of-sample evaluation; pairwise phi/Pearson for binary threshold outcomes plus joint calibration; stability by QB/receiver role and matchup; sample-size interval mandatory.
strategies.status: UNTESTED — correlation and joint pricing unavailable

strategies.name: RB rushing + team result / team total combo
strategies.hypothesis: Model shared game script, team scoring and rushing opportunity jointly; the relationship may change with lead/deficit, opponent and workload. Direction and magnitude are not asserted.
strategies.features: NFL team scoring and rushing stats; game-level settled outcomes and exact price/market terms. Don't infer an individual player's workload from team averages.
strategies.decision: Joint probability must be calibrated on held-out games and priced against the offered combo odds; show correlation and its uncertainty or explicitly abstain.
strategies.validation: Game-block bootstrap, time/season holdouts, joint calibration and stratification by pregame lead/neutral/deficit expectation without leaking final score into features.
strategies.status: UNTESTED — correlation and joint pricing unavailable

correlations.pair: Same-game player props / same-game team outcome
correlations.method: Estimate from the joint distribution of consistently defined binary hit outcomes (phi/Pearson); use game-block bootstrap confidence intervals and report the season, exact lines, book/price timestamp and sample. For pricing, model the joint hit event directly; pairwise correlation alone does not identify all higher-order joint probabilities.
correlations.interpretation: No value can be confirmed from this checkout: no leg-level odds/results dataset was supplied or available. This is deliberately blank, not zero or an assumed correlation.

correlations.method: Estimate separately for outcome dependence and forecast-error dependence using aligned out-of-sample records; report Pearson/phi, uncertainty interval, sample coverage and stability over dates/seasons.
correlations.interpretation: No value can be confirmed without aligned, out-of-sample prediction and settlement data. Independence is an unverified null assumption, not a finding.

correlations.method: For each named pair and exact threshold, compute joint hit frequency and pairwise phi; retain player/game IDs, price timestamp, role and void handling. Cluster resampling at game level; do not generalize a global average across roles.
correlations.interpretation: No numerical values are estimated. The official NFL pages confirm relevant data categories exist, not the pairwise betting correlations.

gates.name: Source and timestamp integrity
gates.test: Every input and price records an official/public source, retrieval time, season, definition and permitted-use status. Missing or stale values remain blank and block affected predictions.
gates.threshold: No undocumented, future-dated or silently imputed inputs; all required fields accounted for.
gates.status: NOT RUN — no feed/data in repository

gates.name: Leakage-safe walk-forward evaluation
gates.test: Build features only from information available before the quoted market timestamp. Split chronologically by game; all preprocessing and calibration fit only on training data. Preserve a never-tuned final holdout.
gates.threshold: Zero known future-information leakage; immutable split and audit trail. Any leakage blocks the strategy.
gates.status: NOT RUN — no dataset or code

gates.name: Probability calibration
gates.test: Assess reliability diagrams plus Brier score and log loss on held-out predictions; compare to a predeclared market/baseline probability and report confidence intervals and sample counts.
gates.threshold: Must beat the declared baseline on the predeclared primary proper scoring metric and show no material calibration failure in supported segments; numeric tolerance/sample-size thresholds are still to be pre-registered, not invented here.

gates.name: Multiple testing / winner's curse
gates.test: Register candidate features, markets, thresholds and model versions; retain all experiments and adjust exploratory hypothesis families for multiplicity; use untouched confirmatory data.
gates.threshold: Unadjusted best backtest is never sufficient; any confirmatory result must survive the predeclared multiplicity and holdout protocol.

gates.name: Price, settlement and line-value audit
gates.test: Store exact available price and line at prediction/bet time, opposite side when needed, close where available, limits, void/push rules, fees and settled outcome. Reproduce net return after costs.
gates.threshold: No edge or ROI claim without complete executable-price and settlement records; no official odds feed/book source configured.

gates.name: Correlation and combo pricing
gates.test: For every combo strategy estimate marginal and joint outcomes out of sample; report coefficient definition, exact line pair, count, interval, stability and joint calibration. Do not set correlation to zero by default.
gates.threshold: No combo approved until joint probability and uncertainty outperform a declared baseline at executable prices; no universal minimum N set without power analysis.
gates.status: BLOCKED — no leg-level joint data; values blank

gates.name: Robustness and live shadow test
gates.test: Use season/role/time subgroup checks and prospective timestamped shadow forecasts before any reward or real-money use; compare locked forecast to close and outcomes.
gates.threshold: All preregistered robustness checks pass; duration/sample and tolerances must be set before the test begins. No live claims until observed.

gates.name: Leaderboard fairness and reward eligibility
gates.test: Score immutable pregame predictions with proper scoring as primary; net yield and closing-line value are secondary and shown with uncertainty. Require public version history, minimum eligibility rule set in advance, and separate exploratory entrants from qualified entries.
gates.threshold: Eligibility and reward value are proposals only. No cash prize/reward schedule is established or funded; do not pay or rank entrants from a tiny, selected sample.
gates.status: PROPOSED — no competition data or rewards configured

leaderboard.definition: Mean squared error between forecast probability and binary outcome on eligible, held-out bets; report sample count, interval and market/baseline comparison.

leaderboard.metric: Primary companion: log loss (lower is better)
leaderboard.definition: Held-out probability score; guard against overconfident forecasts and publish the exact scoring convention.
Compare the locked pregame price/line to a defined close from the same market and settlement rules; no closing-price source is configured.
Report net settled profit divided by total stake with uncertainty, exact price/settlement/void rules and sample size. Descriptive, highly variable and not a stand-alone skill test.

awards.qualification: Best primary proper score among strategies that pass every required gate on the locked holdout; compare like market and forecast horizon only.
awards.proposedReward: Non-cash leaderboard badge and featured strategy card; no monetary value assigned.
awards.guardrail: Publish score, sample size, uncertainty interval, model version and all qualification failures. No award when no entry qualifies.

awards.qualification: Eligible player-prop strategy with calibration and held-out score meeting its preregistered policy; sufficiently supported line/player segments only.
awards.proposedReward: Non-cash category badge; no monetary value assigned.
awards.guardrail: No prize from tiny segments or after tuning on the final holdout; publish sample size and uncertainty.

awards.qualification: Eligible combo model with held-out joint-probability calibration and complete dependence reporting for its registered leg family.
awards.proposedReward: Non-cash category badge; no monetary value assigned.
awards.guardrail: No combo badge without joint outcomes, correlation intervals, exact line definitions and passed joint-validation gate.

irregularities.issue: No sportsbook/market-odds source, executable price feed, or price history is present. NFL stats pages do not establish offered lines or prices.
irregularities.impact: No fair-line-versus-market comparison, expected value, CLV, ROI, or actual bet recommendation can be calculated.
irregularities.action: Keep all odds, probabilities, edge, CLV and return fields blank until an authorized, reproducible odds source is configured.

irregularities.issue: No play-by-play, historical odds, settled bet ledger, prop-line archive, or joint leg outcomes were supplied. Official NFL public pages confirm stats categories, but do not provide this project's complete joined modeling dataset.
irregularities.impact: Strategies cannot pass validation; empirical accuracy, skill, leaderboard order and correlation values remain unknown.
irregularities.action: Treat every candidate as untested; acquire permitted historical data, define exact market settlement, preserve prediction timestamps and run chronological holdouts before any ranking.

irregularities.issue: The NFL tracking-data page describes detailed NGS collection and metrics but does not establish public access rights to all raw tracking fields or commercial-use terms.
irregularities.impact: Do not design an automated production feed or assume public commercial redistribution from the overview page alone.
irregularities.action: Verify field-level access, license, rate limits and redistribution rights directly with NFL/NFL data provider before building ingestion.

irregularities.issue: The NFL rule PDF verified here is for the 2025 season; rules and market settlement definitions may differ in later seasons or at individual operators.
irregularities.impact: A rule-sensitive model or bet settlement can be wrong if rules/terms are carried forward without verification.
irregularities.action: Recheck the current NFL rules and the selected operator's current market terms before each season; do not infer the 2026 rulebook from this 2025 PDF.

irregularities.issue: No empirical correlation coefficient can be calculated from the files in this repository.
irregularities.impact: Assuming zero dependence would misprice parlays and prop combos; a source link for the Pearson definition is not evidence of an NFL-specific value.
irregularities.action: All coefficient/sample cells remain blank and flagged until actual, aligned joint observations are analyzed.

irregularities.issue: No leaderboard entrants, reward funding, rules, or historical competition outcomes exist in the repository.
irregularities.impact: No top-performing strategy, winner, prize amount or reward can be factually declared.
irregularities.action: The displayed ranking and rewards are a proposed design only; use a simulated, non-cash eligibility period unless and until independently authorized and funded.
